title: Ensure a minimum number of administrators are set for the repository
description: A repository with one administrator is a repository whose settings become unmaintainable the moment that person is unavailable — and whose branch protections nobody else can restore.
remediation: Repository settings -> Repository permissions: grant "Admin" to at least one more trusted maintainer, or grant "Admin" at Project settings -> Project permissions so a group covers all repositories in the project. Adjust the minimum with thresholds.minRepositoryAdmins in bitbucket-bench's config.
fixSummary: Grant "Admin" to another trusted maintainer at Repository settings -> Repository permissions.
